## SYNOPSIS

Closes a progress window opened by Show-FluenceProgress.

## SYNTAX

```powershell
Close-FluenceProgress [-Handle] <ProgressHandle>
```

## DESCRIPTION

Closes the window on its UI thread and marks the handle closed.
Closing an already closed
handle is a no-op, so a finally block can call this unconditionally.
On an MTA host this also
ends the UI pump that kept the window live and releases the module's UI runspace for the next
dialog.

## EXAMPLES

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
try { $progress = Show-FluenceProgress -Message 'Working...'; Invoke-Work } finally { Close-FluenceProgress -Handle $progress }
```

## OUTPUTS

## NOTES

Runs on the UI thread that owns the window.
A window implies a running Application, so no
application is created here.
